title: Balanced root systems and a Schellekens-type list for holomorphic vertex operator algebras of central charge $32$
summary: We study a special class of holomorphic vertex operator algebras (VOAs) that we call \emph{balanced}.\ For a balanced, holomorphic VOA $V=\mathbb{C}\mathbf{1}\oplus V_1\oplus\dots$ with $c=32$ or $40$ we show that the Virasoro vectors of $V$ and the subVOA generated by $V_1$ coincide and use this result to provide a Schellekens-type list of possible root systems that may occur.
